pages.text: {{hero}} has a big red truck. It can go up and up. {{hero}} and Dad sit in it. Zip, zip! It is fun.
{{hero}} and Dad have a job. The job is to get ten big bags to Gus. Gus is at his hut.
But the mud is wet. The big truck sat in the mud. It can not go! {{hero}} and Dad tug and tug.
{{hero}} gets ten logs. {{hero}} sets the logs in the mud. The truck gets on the logs. It can go! Gus gets his bags.
The sun is set. {{hero}} is in bed. Mom and Dad hug {{hero}}. But Gus has a box for {{hero}}. What is in the box?
